source: Sally v2 six axes and 16 half-names (../sally-v2-2026-09-26/v2-system-64types-tags.md), reworked per BRIEF.md: English first, gender neutral, meme-style, all names our own, no diagnoses or moral grades. Sally's Chinese kept as zh.

axes.plusLine: You recharge with your people. Close means shared.
axes.minusLine: You love hard and keep your own door. Close still means space.

axes.plusLine: You say the hard thing to their face, because that's respect.
axes.minusLine: You hold the person first. The hard part can wait for a gentler moment.

axes.plusLine: Traditions, rituals and how a home should run feel like home to you.
axes.minusLine: You write your own script for love, home and holidays.

axes.plusLine: Security first. Your leaps come with a safety net.
axes.minusLine: New city, new plan, new try. The unknown pulls you in.

axes.plusLine: You want visible wins and a clear direction, sooner rather than later.
axes.minusLine: You run on your own clock. Other people's timelines are optional.

axes.plusLine: A fair process keeps everyone safe. A rule is a rule.
axes.minusLine: You read the room. Rules bend when a person needs them to.

relationship.name: Trash-Talking Cuddle Bug
relationship.desc: You want your people close, always. You show it by roasting them, saying it straight and writing your own rules for love.
relationship.sting: You call them annoying. Your real fear is the day they stop annoying you.
relationship.heart: I'm clingy and I tell the truth. You get the full set.

relationship.name: Family CEO
relationship.desc: You're the hub of your people. You carry the load, make the call and keep the traditions running on time.
relationship.sting: Everyone leans on you. Nobody has asked if you're tired.
relationship.heart: I can carry it all, and I deserve to be carried too.

relationship.name: Open-Book Golden Retriever
relationship.desc: You love out loud and in full view: warm, gentle, all in, and never by anyone else's rulebook.
relationship.sting: You give so fast that you're running on empty before anyone notices.
relationship.heart: I'd rather love too much than too carefully.

relationship.name: Human Weighted Blanket
relationship.desc: You keep everyone's feelings and every tradition safe: the birthday texts, the holiday dishes, the seat saved for whoever's late.
relationship.sting: You check on everyone's feelings. Yours are always last on the list.

relationship.name: No-Filter Free Agent
relationship.desc: In any relationship you're yourself first. Boundaries said out loud, script written by you.
relationship.sting: You rarely get hurt, because you rarely let anyone that close.
relationship.heart: My clear head is how I keep myself safe.

relationship.name: Old-School Final Boss
relationship.desc: You believe in the classic way to love and live, but nobody, ever, makes your decisions for you.
relationship.sting: You want old-school love without handing over any of the control.
relationship.heart: I can want tradition and freedom. Both. At once.

relationship.name: Soft-Spoken Rebel
relationship.desc: Gentle voice, iron line, and a life that follows no template anyone handed you.
relationship.sting: Everyone thinks you're easygoing, right up until they step on your line.
relationship.heart: Soft is not the same as a pushover.

relationship.name: Do-Not-Disturb Homebody
relationship.desc: You love the cozy, traditional kind of home, speak gently, and still need hours alone behind your own door.
relationship.sting: You want a home. You want a door that locks even more.
relationship.heart: Love with a little distance is still deep love.

life.name: Color-Coded Overachiever
life.desc: You want big wins, and every step toward them is planned, checked and done by the book.
life.sting: Your plan is flawless. You just keep not pressing start.
life.heart: Slow, maybe. But every step I take counts.

life.name: Low-Key Tryhard
life.desc: You're climbing, and you know when to take the side road, but you never bet your safety net to get there.
life.sting: You want to be seen, but you won't let go of safe long enough to be.

life.name: Slow-and-Steady Regular
life.desc: Your days run on routine and order, and you're in no rush to prove anything to anyone.
life.sting: Your life is so steady that some nights you wonder if it's too steady.
life.heart: I chose my ordinary days. I didn't settle for them.

life.name: Chill Personified
life.desc: You don't race anyone's timeline. You go with the flow, but you never blow the budget doing it.
life.sting: You're not unambitious. Nothing has been worth the grind yet.
life.heart: My life doesn't need a progress bar.

life.name: Calculated Daredevil
life.desc: You jump, but only after you've scouted the landing, packed a plan B and read the fine print.
life.sting: You say you love risk. Every leap you've taken had a backup plan.
life.heart: Brave and careful. I get to be both.

life.name: Full-Send Trailblazer
life.desc: You want something big and you'll trade certainty to get it. Rules are negotiable; the mission isn't.
life.sting: You'd rather regret doing it. Sometimes the bill for that is steep.
life.heart: Even if I lose, I get a great story.

life.name: Side-Quest Knight
life.desc: You chase the new, skip the main quest, and still live by a personal code nobody can talk you out of.
life.sting: You've gone far. You've rarely said where you're going.
life.heart: Being on the road is my answer.

life.name: Vibes-Based Wanderer
life.desc: You follow your curiosity wherever it goes. Rules and timelines are suggestions; the vibe decides.
life.sting: Freedom is your superpower. It's also your favorite excuse.
life.heart: I travel light, and I live true.

typeCodeRule: relationship code | life code, e.g. We·Direct·Classic | Steady·Push·Rules

flex.line: You live on both sides of this one. Genii couldn't call it, and honestly, neither could you.

unfinished.line: This side isn't finished yet. Two more cards and Genii can call it.
